summary: First-finish smoke test for Lantern Realm Codex. Backend public endpoints, auth (DM + Co-DM), protected CRUD, and full frontend flow (home, category nav, search, detail, login, admin create/edit/pin/delete, logout) all pass functionally. One real backend bug: /api/auth/logout uses response.delete_cookie() with default SameSite=Lax (no Secure flag), while login sets SameSite=None+Secure cookies. Browsers and curl treat the deletion as a different cookie, so the httpOnly access_token is never cleared — the user remains authenticated via cookies until the JWT expires. Frontend masks this with local state clearing, but server-side session is not actually invalidated.
passed: GET /api/entries returns 7 seeded entries with pinned-first ordering (the-lantern-realm, mirewatch, the-order-of-wicks pinned)
GET /api/entries?category=location returns only Mirewatch
GET /api/entries/mirewatch resolves by slug; unknown slug returns 404
GET /api/stats returns {overview:1, location:1, character:1, faction:1, lore:1, session:1, bestiary:1}
POST /api/auth/login DM credentials -> 200, user JSON, access_token+refresh_token cookies set
POST /api/auth/login wrong password -> 401
POST /api/auth/login Co-DM credentials -> 200
GET /api/auth/me with cookies -> 200; without cookies -> 401
POST /api/entries without auth -> 401; with auth -> 200 creates entry and appears in GET /api/entries
PUT /api/entries/{id} (full EntryIn body) updates fields with auth
DELETE /api/entries/{id} returns 200 with auth
Frontend home renders home-page, cta-explore, all six tome-{category} cards
Nav to /locations, /characters, /factions, /lore, /sessions, /bestiary each show their seeded entry-card-{slug}
Search 'mire' on /locations filters to a single Mirewatch card
Click Mirewatch card -> /locations/mirewatch shows detail-mirewatch; back-link returns to list
/admin redirects to /login when anonymous; DM login navigates to admin-page
Admin new-entry-btn opens editor-drawer; creating 'Thorne the Quick' (character) shows row-thorne-the-quick in admin list
Edit and pin actions on the new row succeed (drawer pre-fills, save updates list, pin toggles)
Admin delete removes the row
logout-btn clears local auth state; login-link reappears in header

failed.issue: /api/auth/logout sets Set-Cookie with SameSite=Lax and no Secure flag, but login uses SameSite=None; Secure. The mismatched attributes mean clients (browsers + curl) do not overwrite/remove the original cookie. Verified: after POST /api/auth/logout the access_token cookie remains in curl's cookie jar and GET /api/auth/me still returns 200 with that cookie. Server-side the JWT remains valid until expiry.
failed.evidence: Set-Cookie headers from logout: 'access_token=""; ... SameSite=lax' (no Secure). Original login Set-Cookie: 'access_token=...; Secure; SameSite=none'. After logout, /api/auth/me with the same jar -> 200 returning DM user.

action_items: In /app/backend/server.py clear_auth_cookies(): call response.delete_cookie('access_token', path='/', samesite='none', secure=True) and same for refresh_token so the attributes match the cookie that was set, allowing browsers/curl to actually remove them. Alternatively set both cookies to empty value with Max-Age=0, Secure=True, SameSite='none'.
notes: PUT /api/entries/{id} requires the full EntryIn body (category, title, summary mandatory) — initial partial PUT returned 422. Confirmed by-design; frontend Admin editor sends full payload.
Public pages trigger /api/auth/me which returns 401 for anonymous visitors — expected (AuthContext probe), produces harmless console 401s.
